defect.message: The plain laminated elastomeric bearings are described only by type ("plain laminated elastomeric bearings, one under each girder end; four internal rubber layers 8 mm thick"). The bearing plan dimensions a and b (plan length/width, or the standard bearing model designation) are not given. These are required inputs: the shape factor is S = a·b/(2·t1·(a+b)) (JTG 3362-2018 8.7), the vertical stiffness Kv = count·a·b/(te·(1/Ee + 1/Eb))·1000 with Ee = 5.4·Ge·S² and the shear stiffness Kh = count·Ge·a·b/te·1000. The number of layers (4) and the layer thickness (8 mm) determine only te and t1, so a and b cannot be derived from the statements given, and the support springs cannot be computed. The description must also supply the elastomer shear modulus Ge if a non-standard value is intended; otherwise the standard Ge is assumed.
